notes: See _bmad-output/clinova/02-ux-specification.md §2 for the rationale behind keeping tagline and hero_headline as two distinct strings. `common` and `screens` were added in Phase 5 Epic 5.7: workspace screens previously hardcoded their own copy, so the same sentence appeared in up to 10 separate files and could not be corrected in one place -- which is exactly how the 'runs only come from Streamlit' empty state survived past the web app gaining its own New Run screen. `common` is read by BOTH stacks (apps/web/lib/copy.ts and apps/api/services/copy_text.py): the same six services were still hardcoding that false sentence into their API `empty_reason` after the web-side fix, so the duplication had only moved a layer down. Screens whose description is genuinely per-run (it names the basis run and its id) keep building that string at render time and are absent here on purpose.
